query_name:
select b.* replace (coalesce(f.is_st, b.is_st) as is_st, case when f.is_st is not null then f.source else b.is_st_source end as is_st_source, coalesce(f.trading_status, b.trading_status) as trading_status, case when f.trading_status is not null then f.source else b.trading_status_source end as trading_status_source, coalesce(f.pre_close, case when r.symbol is not null then case when st.trade_date is null then r.reference_pre_close end else b.pre_close end) as pre_close, case when f.pre_close is not null then f.source else case when r.symbol is not null then 'limit_derived:' || r.basis else b.pre_close_source end end as pre_close_source) from _daily_contract_rows b left join (
            select r.symbol, r.trade_date, r.reference_pre_close, r.basis
            from daily_limit_references r
            join daily_limit_publication p using (trade_date, batch_id)
            where exists (select 1 from _daily_contract_rows k
                          where k.symbol=r.symbol and k.date=r.trade_date)
        ) r on r.symbol=b.symbol and r.trade_date=b.date
        left join daily_limit_staleness st on st.trade_date=r.trade_date left join (select is_st, pre_close, source, symbol, trade_date, trading_status from security_daily_facts f where exists (select 1 from _daily_contract_rows k where k.symbol=f.symbol and k.date=f.trade_date)) f on f.symbol=b.symbol and f.trade_date=b.date order by b.symbol, b.date

Conditions: trade_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM trade_date
symbol IS NOT DISTINCT FROM symbol
